propositions: AGENTS.md incorrectly claims symbol tools are reliably superior to grep, but LSP cannot resolve symbols referenced via string literals in calls like monkeypatch.setattr()
A decision table should replace the unconditional preference, specifying when to use Serena find_referencing_symbols versus grep versus working-tree grep for different lookup scenarios
LSP indexes can lag behind recent edits in the same session, causing reported line numbers to be stale relative to the current working tree
Documentation must explicitly name the string-literal blind spot with concrete examples to prevent agents from discounting the rule entirely
The updated rule must remain concise per AGENTS.md's own leanness standard, with supporting evidence moved to docs/ rather than inline
